question: calculate 2023 ANC coverage rate minus 2021 rate in percentage points for Gaya and Nalanda
gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
sql_duckdb: WITH coverage_2023 AS (SELECT district, pregnancies_registered, anc4_completed FROM anc_visits WHERE year = 2023 AND district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')), coverage_2021 AS (SELECT district, pregnancies_registered, anc4_completed FROM anc_visits WHERE year = 2021 AND district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')) SELECT (CAST(coverage_2023.pregnancies_registered AS REAL) - CAST(coverage_2021.pregnancies_registered AS REAL)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(coverage_2023.anc4_completed, 0), 0) AS change FROM coverage_2023 JOIN coverage_2021 ON coverage_2023.district = coverage_2021.district
